description: This file defines a Swing-based graphical user interface for a food ordering system. It includes categories such as Dosa, Punjabi, Chinese, Fast Food, and Pizza, with checkbox selections and corresponding quantity input fields. The class manages cost calculations, receipt generation, and user interactions with buttons for total calculation, reset, and exit.
